about: Reading a configuration value: the user asks a question and gets the right answer.
THESE ROWS DO NOT REQUIRE A read_config CALL, and that is a decision rather than an
oversight. The agent's own instructions and skills are RENDERED INTO ITS WORKSPACE, so a
question about them is already answerable from context, and the first smoke run confirmed it:
claude-haiku answered the escalation code correctly with zero tool calls. Demanding the call
would score a correct answer as a failure and would measure mechanism, which this benchmark
deliberately does not do. The wire record still stores every call, so any analysis that wants
the read rate can have it.
What the rendered copy CANNOT do is stay current: it is written at session start, so after an
out-of-band change it is stale, and answering from it is wrong. That case is
`fm-02-stale-recitation`, and it is where reading is genuinely load-bearing.
Every answer here is a per-trial random {{TOKEN}} or a seeded name, so a correct answer
cannot come from the model's priors.

scenarios.title: read one value out of the instructions
scenarios.prompt_note: How a human asks: no field path, no tool name, no mention of configuration.

turns.prompt: what's the escalation code i'm supposed to use when i page someone?

scenarios.title: read a list out of the configuration
scenarios.prompt_note: The names are seeded, so a correct answer cannot come from priors either.

turns.prompt: what skills do i have set up right now?
